name: dsh-softui-skin
description: Neumorphism soft-UI skin for DeepSeek Harness web — gentle raised-and-recessed surfaces in a cream light and an ink-dark palette, switched by one native toggle in 设置 → 通用设置 → 外观. The light/dark variant always mirrors the harness's native appearance; the choice survives refresh and restart. · DeepSeek Harness 轻拟物皮肤:设置-通用设置-外观中的系统原生开关,浅色/深色跟随系统原生外观,刷新、关闭后不会还原。修改自 Lhy723/dsh-neu-theme (MIT)。
author: Vast-Unhurried
